svg.title: Realmroot connects an Agent to multiple resource servers
svg.desc: An Agent discovers and receives authority through Realmroot, then calls APIs directly across Support, Storage, and Payments resource servers. Each resource server registers and publishes its own API group through Realmroot.

g.text: EXECUTION PLANE · ORIGINAL SERVICES KEEP ENFORCEMENT
TRUST PLANE · OFF THE DATA PATH
3 RESOURCE SERVERS · 9 APIs · ONE AGENT TOOL PLANE
